block.createdecals.decal_block.tooltip.a: Recolours the decal on that face.
block.createdecals.decal_block.tooltip.s: A full _copycat block_ with a _decal_ on any of its faces, for hulls built of whole blocks.
block.createdecals.decal_panel.tooltip.b: Copies that block's look, as Create's Copycat Panel does.
block.createdecals.decal_panel.tooltip.s: A _copycat panel_ that shows a _decal_ on its front: stripes, numbers, letters, emblems. Keeps it on contraptions, trains and Sable vehicles.
